Hi all - happy to draft and share. TL;DR answers below, full summary attached.

SOC 2: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II for the platform/control baseline on 2026-11-15. The summary report (control coverage and test period) is included in the SOC2_summary section of our compliance pack; full report is shared under NDA.

Pen test (third-party): 
- Vendor: GreyBoxSec (independent 3rd party)
- Test date: 2026-10-22 to 2026-10-24
- Report: Full report available under NDA. Attached is a redacted executive summary (Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf) that lists top findings and remediation status as of 2027-02-01.

Vulnerability management / scanning cadence: 
- Continuous external scanning (weekly) + authenticated internal scans (bi-weekly).
- Dependabot-style dependency alerts on code repos; container scans on every build.
- KV cache / runtime infra scans are scheduled weekly with higher-frequency monitoring for CVE feeds.

SLAs for remediation (internal target / typical): 
- Critical (P1): acknowledge within 2 hours, mitigation/patch or workaround within 24-72 hours depending on severity and remediation complexity. Communication updates at 4, 12, 24 hours.
- High (P2): remediation within 7 days typical window; mitigations/compensating controls applied where full fix requires longer change window.
- Medium/Low: tracked in backlog; remediation cadence depends on release cycles (30-90 days typical).

Disclosure policy: Redwood follows coordinated disclosure. We aim to notify affected customers for any findings that could impact confidentiality/integrity within 48 hours and publish advisories when appropriate. Full disclosure timeline and escalation path are in the attached Remediation_SLAs.xlsx.

Next steps: 
1) I attached the redacted pen test exec summary and the SLA spreadsheet.
2) If FinHealth wants the full report, we can share after a mutual NDA - Steph, can you send the DocuSign NDA?
3) I'm happy to set a short call if FinHealth wants to walk through the findings.

--
Rishi Malhotra
